questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Some of the courses are more time-consuming and seem to be at a good academic level, while others are very easy. Overall, the academic level varies significantly.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: There was much more group work, and the final grade depended heavily on the other students in the group you were assigned to, more so than I have ever experienced before. As an exchange student, I found this quite problematic because students who had already worked together for a long time tended to stick to their established groups. As a result, I was placed with students who were either unmotivated or lazy, and I ended up completing most of the assignments myself. Therefore, I believe the teaching approach at UCPH is better, as it emphasizes taking responsibility for your own learning and outcomes, making it much harder to freeride through a semester.
